title: Restore PipeShare login splash video logo
description:
Recent deploys left login using the old CSS PIPE+SHARE wordmark because the zero-seam splash video and poster were never on the GITHUBS deploy tree (404 on live). Restores assets/pipeshare-login-zero-seam.mp4 + poster.png, switches the React login mark back to the video with poster/PNG fallback, and cache-busts login-main.js.

Who is affected: anyone opening the PipeShare login page on BASE (pipeshare.live) and SaaS after peer apply.
changeLog: Add pipeshare-login-zero-seam.mp4 and poster.png to frontend assets
Login splash uses zero-seam video again (poster/PNG fallback)
